literal: He who lacks character obtained great wealth, good milk vessel's impurity by turned sour, is like that.
translation: The great wealth acquired by a person devoid of good character is like good milk turning sour due to the impurity of the vessel it is kept in.
modern: நற்பண்பு இல்லாதவன் பெற்ற பெரும் செல்வமானது, பாத்திரத்தின் குற்றத்தால் நல்ல பால் கெட்டுப் போவதைப் போன்றதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet compares the wealth of an uncultured person to good milk poured into an unclean vessel. Just as the impurity of the container spoils the pure, nourishing milk, the lack of character in a person ruins the utility of their vast wealth. Wealth in the hands of the characterless becomes useless and harmful to society, rather than being beneficial. Thus, personal character is the essential vessel that preserves and gives value to one's fortune.
